author: Pamela W Bell
text: The Libre 3 app stopped working for me saying "signal loss". The reason, according to Abbott, is that the app only works with iPhone 15 Pro up to version 17.5.1. My phone updated to version 18.3 and it stopped working. Now I have to use the reader that came with it which is annoying having to carry around an extra piece of equipment. Does anyone know when Abbot will update their app? They couldn't tell me. Said I just had to use the reader or another phone. I'm not very happy right now.
